If you prefer a single, highly-rated vegetarian-friendly Thai spot that isn’t a chain, consider “Siam Thai” in the West Loop or “Baan Thai” in the West Loop – both have dedicated vegetarian menus and rave reviews.)*

**Quick Tips**

1. **Call Ahead** – Even though most of these places list vegetarian options online, calling a few minutes before you go can confirm availability and any special requests (e.g., no peanuts, gluten-free).
2. **Ask for “Veggie” Versions** – Many Thai restaurants will make a dish vegetarian on request (e.g., “Pad Thai (Veggie)” or “Green Curry (Veggie)”).
3. **Check the Menu Online** – Most restaurants post their menus on their website or on Google Maps. Look for “Vegetarian” or “Vegan” tags.
4. **Try the “Vegetarian” Section** – Some places have a dedicated vegetarian section on the menu (e.g., “Vegetarian Pad Thai”, “Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup”).

Enjoy your Thai meal! If you’d like more specific details (hours, reservations, or a different neighborhood), just let me know.
